content.text:
**Repaired finding submitted: deviation (high), Section 7.7 (p0032).**

Changes made in response to the feedback:

- **Restored the ten-day trigger.** The edit no longer touches payment timing — the replacement now starts after "within ten days of its due date," so no unrelated commercial concession is embedded.
- **Dropped the "undisputed" insertion.** Section 7.3 already lets us withhold genuinely disputed amounts and bars interest on sums ultimately not due, so no layering was needed.
- **Dropped the blanket "Customer owes no liquidated damages… under this Agreement" sentence.** It swept wider than this clause; the targeted deletion is sufficient to reach the preferred position.
- **Comment now discloses everything that changed:** deletion of the 15%-per-week LD, the new 1%/month interest cap, the "Vendor's sole remedy" limitation, and an express statement that the ten-day trigger and Section 7.3 mechanics are unchanged.
- **"Applicable Law" confirmed defined** at Section 1.2, so the interest cap's reference is sound.

The scope conclusions are unchanged: no early-termination fee elsewhere (Section 9.4 limits us to accrued Fees), so the three-month fallback is unnecessary, and Section 21 preserves no penalty against us.
